_readme: One-time MDMS schema creation for the DST campaign config mirror. POST to <mdms-url>/mdms-v2/schema/v1/_create (or the env's egov-mdms-service schema create endpoint) once per environment root tenant. Internal call — dummy authToken suffices.

RequestInfo.msgId: create dst campaign report config schema

SchemaDefinitions.description: DST daily campaign reporting config, mirrored one-way from the team's Google Sheet by the dst_config_sync DAG. One entry per campaign row; data.row carries the 22 sheet columns as strings. Do not edit entries by hand - the sheet overwrites them on the next sync tick.

rowIdentity.description: tenant::campaignNumber::cycle::campaignStart (projectTypeId then state_name fall back for the campaign part). Cycle and start are in the key because a campaign number is NOT unique per cycle — Chad C1 and C2 share CMP-2026-06-27-000416. Stable across edits; a new cycle is a new entry.

deploymentGroup.description: Sheet tab / credential group this campaign belongs to (e.g. nigeria_states, togo)

row.description: The campaign config row, mirrored from the Google Sheet. All values are strings. Legacy aliases still accepted by the pipeline but not part of this schema: target_csv (-> target_file), out_dir, lgas_total, project_type, secondary_products.

active.description: TRUE schedules this campaign; anything else is ignored

campaign_name.description: Report titles and Drive folder name

state_name.description: Display label and Run Log key

tenant.description: ES tenant code, lowercase - drives index names

drug_type.description: SPAQ | AZM | ITN | LLIN; ITN/LLIN select the household-grain modules

campaign_start.description: YYYY-MM-DD; the day number is computed from this

campaign_end.description: YYYY-MM-DD; no daily run fires outside the window

mopup_end_date.description: Optional YYYY-MM-DD. Set = the whole-campaign cumulative report runs at 23:59 UTC that day and posts to BOTH channels. Blank = never

is_admin_console.description: TRUE scopes by campaign_number, FALSE by project_type_id

cycle_index.description: Zero-padded in ES ('02'); _pad_cycle normalises bare digits

dose_index_filter.description: TRUE adds doseIndex=1 to the treatment query

task_campaign_filter.description: TRUE applies the campaign filter to the task query; required where several project types share a tenant and date range

target_file.description: File name of the target book inside DST_TARGET_FOLDER_ID; blank falls back to <tenant>_target.csv

slack_channel_partners.description: Partner Slack channel id; blank means no partner report is built

secondary_product.description: Extra product counted alongside the primary drug; blank disables
